title: Run lotteries only under the exclusive lottery licence
what: The lottery licence issued to the corporation may be exclusive for a specified term, and may carry conditions about its exclusive right to conduct gaming schemes.

sources.title: Lotteries Act 1997 (Qld)
sources.quote: 237 Corporation’s exclusive rights (1) This section applies if the Minister issues a lottery licence to the corporation before issuing a lottery licence to another person. (2) The lottery licence may be issued as an exclusive licence for a specified term and on specified conditions. (3) The lottery licence may be issued on conditions about the exclusive right of the corporation to conduct certain gaming schemes or classes of gaming schemes.

assessment.summary: The lottery licence first issued to the corporation the Act names may be exclusive for a set term. A statutory route to an exclusive right to run lotteries.

marks.reason: An exclusive lottery licence keeps other operators out for its term.
The licensee faces no lottery rival in Queensland.
